title: On Sleeping for twelve hours at a stretch
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：sleep　|　正文 361 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sleep 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the trader ① slept for twelve hours at a stretch on the same day, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the trader ② sleeps for twelve hours at a stretch before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ sleep for twelve hours at a stretch at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ slept for twelve hours at a stretch before — a line in the list for October 1947 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sleeping for twelve hours at a stretch on the same day, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ sleep in the loft through the winter before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Sleep in the loft through the winter at once and never mention it again.

By 1960 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new partner from the next market ⑧ sleeps in the loft through the winter on the same day every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ slept for twelve hours at a stretch again when nobody else would.

⑩ To sleep for twelve hours at a stretch, my mother said in 1965, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the market remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the market forgets, somebody sleeps for twelve hours at a stretch before dawn again and somebody must sleep for twelve hours at a stretch on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 睡（一般过去式 slept for twelve hours at a stretch：1953 年货商头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 睡（一般现在 sleeps for twelve hours at a stretch：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 睡（不定式 to sleep for twelve hours at a stretch：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 睡（过去完成时 had slept for twelve hours at a stretch：1947 年十月的货单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 睡（动名词 sleeping for twelve hours at a stretch 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 睡着（sleep in the loft through the winter：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去睡着整个冬天睡在阁楼上）
G. v. 睡着（sleep in the loft through the winter：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 睡（后段两处：新来的伙计照例 sleeps in the loft through the winter，而母亲又一次 slept for twelve hours at a stretch）

answers.why: sleep 意为“睡”，1953 年货商当天就睡一口气睡了十二个钟头，那是集市里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 slept。
sleep 意为“睡”，自那以后货商天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sleeps。
sleep 意为“睡”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯睡一口气睡了十二个钟头”，此处为不定式 to sleep for twelve hours at a stretch。
sleep 意为“睡”，货单里 十月 那行字说明早在 1960 年之前就有人睡过，故用过去完成时 had slept。
sleep 意为“睡”，货商说“睡一口气睡了十二个钟头这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 sleeping for twelve hours at a stretch 作主语。
sleep 意为“睡着”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去睡着整个冬天睡在阁楼上”，should ever 之后用原形 sleep in the loft through the winter。
sleep 意为“睡着”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻睡着整个冬天睡在阁楼上（sleep in the loft through the winter at once），以后再也不要提起。
sleep 意为“睡”，新来的伙计每个星期都照例睡着整个冬天睡在阁楼上，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sleeps。
sleep 意为“睡”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就睡一口气睡了十二个钟头，用一般过去式 slept 叙述。
sleep 意为“睡”，结尾那句是母亲 1965 年的话：要睡一口气睡了十二个钟头，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和集市记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sleep 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the trader slept for twelve hours at a stretch on the same day, and nobody in the market forgot it.
Even now the trader sleeps for twelve hours at a stretch before dawn whenever the market asks.
Sleeping for twelve hours at a stretch on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever sleep in the loft through the winter before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new partner from the next market sleeps in the loft through the winter on the same day every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother slept for twelve hours at a stretch again, and the market remembered that half.
